listed.name: Anthropic
listed.summary: Claude AI models and enterprise APIs; Nasdaq-listed as ANT since 19 November 2026. The 20 November IPO close confirmed a $93.5bn gross Class A share sale and separate $26bn Class N strategic placement; sale proceeds are not revenue.

latest_development.text: Nasdaq confirmed on 19 November that Anthropic began public trading under ANT and opened at $111.50 per share. Reuters reported the first session close was $97.17. The $83 issuer offering price on 18 November is a separate allocation price.

ipo_closing.text: Actual 20 November IPO closing: 1,127,000,000 Class A shares at $83, including 1,103,351,354 newly issued shares; approximately $93.5bn public gross including the selling holders' portion. Concurrent separate $26bn Class N placement.

private.name: OpenAI
private.summary: Privately held AI model and enterprise platform provider; on 22 November its chief scientist proposed shared cross-lab pretraining-loss measurements to inform future safety thresholds, without an agreed development cap.

latest_development.text: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki on 22 November proposed common evaluation of held-out pretraining prediction loss (log-perplexity) to inform cross-industry AI safety pacing. The internally reported benchmark is dataset-dependent; the proposal is not a binding pact, law, or company-wide training pause.

private.name: ByteDance
private.summary: TikTok, Douyin, digital content distribution, AI systems, and proposed private-shareholder liquidity arrangements.

latest_development.text: Reuters on 13 November reported The Information's unverified proposal for a ByteDance repurchase of up to $6 billion of shares at a reported $400 billion private valuation; Bloomberg separately reported a proposed $241.35 per-share price and extension of an IPO-or-liquidity deadline to December 2030. These are attributed press accounts of proposed terms, not a confirmed completed buyback or IPO date.

private.name: Databricks
private.summary: Private enterprise data and AI platform; Nov 19 cross-regulatory-domain OpenSharing generally available for supported commercial/government cloud pairs, subject to customer governance and phased workspace access.

latest_development.text: Databricks' November product notes announced generally available cross-regulatory-domain Databricks-to-Databricks Delta Sharing on 19 November 2026 for supported pairs including commercial workspaces and AWS GovCloud, AWS GovCloud DoD and Azure China. Some combinations remain unsupported. Technical access does not confer legal permission or disclose revenue attributable to this feature.

private.name: Stripe
private.summary: Payments infrastructure, bank-embedded merchant acceptance, financial services and software tooling.

latest_development.text: Stripe said on 24 November that Stripe Issuing powers Deel's new stablecoin-funded prepaid Visa card for contractors in 26 markets across Latin America, the Caribbean and Africa, with Bridge issuing the DLUSD stablecoin and Privy powering the wallet. No partnership revenue, fee split, card adoption or Irish availability was disclosed.

private.name: Revolut
private.summary: Private financial technology company offering consumer and business banking and payments; Italian branch subject to a preventive court-supervised AML remediation order reported 16 November.

latest_development.text: Reuters, citing a 39-page Milan court ruling, reported that Revolut Bank UAB's Italian operation was put under one-year judicial administration concerning AML controls. Reuters said Revolut itself was not under criminal investigation, services were uninterrupted and oversight applied only in Italy.

private.name: Blue Origin
private.summary: Privately held launch, engine and space-infrastructure firm; New Glenn selected under Google's 19 November Project Suncatcher launch agreement targeting a first dedicated mission in Q1 2029.

latest_development.text: Blue Origin said Google selected New Glenn for the first dedicated heavy-lift launch of Project Suncatcher's planned solar-powered TPU computing satellites, targeted for Q1 2029. Price, launch cadence, margins and satellite compute economics were not disclosed; the mission has not flown.

private.name: Anduril Industries
private.summary: Privately held defence technology developer of Lattice autonomy, maritime and airborne systems; ASV Alpha prototype launched with HD Hyundai at Ulsan in November 2026.

latest_development.text: HD Hyundai announced on 15 November that it and Anduril had launched the roughly 600-tonne ASV Alpha at Ulsan on 12 November, using VAone for shipboard autonomy and Anduril Lattice for missions. Sea trials were planned in Korea and US testing in early 2027. No funded US Navy production order or unit price was disclosed.

private.name: Canva
private.summary: Privately held visual-design and collaboration company. Its 19 November AI Controls add individual generation opt-outs and reduced AI-generated library discovery for Free and Pro users.

latest_development.text: Canva introduced two AI Controls on 19 November 2026: a generative-AI feature switch and a separate option to reduce AI-generated content in discovery, without extra charges on Free and Pro. Assistive editing remains accessible and no customer-revenue impact was disclosed.

private.name: LEGO Group
private.summary: Privately held Danish toy maker; 21 November 2026 Las Vegas Formula 1 LEGO Race promotion accompanied an announced 2027 Speed Champions portfolio covering 11 teams and 22 drivers.

latest_development.text: LEGO reported an F1-themed Las Vegas celebrity event with 11 custom-built minicars and 6,400 development hours; an 18 November announcement described LEGO Speed Champions sets for 11 F1 teams and 22 drivers scheduled for sale from 1 March 2027. Campaign returns, royalties and sales impact were not disclosed.
